about: The hottest D&B, exclusives and big guests.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 22 Dec. The biggest D&B with Charlie Tee, and a Drop of the Week from Harriet Jaxxon! Plus dive deep into the rave scene with Charlie's Rave Revival selection, where she spins an older track that's been going off in sets at the moment. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: with Charlie Tee: Harriet Jaxxon Drop of the Week

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. All the backstage goss from Boomtown 2026, plus exclusive live sets from Sub Focus, Lens and Wilkinson! Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Boomtown special with Charlie Tee

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. Charlie Tee crowns a luscious new Drop of the Week from 1991 and Grace Barton. Plus the excitement is building for Boomtown with the announcement of Noisia as one of the headliners for 2027! Charlie celebrates by playing a classic track from Noisia as her Rave Revival selection, and we hear from A.M.C ahead of an exclusive play of his Boomtown 2026 set. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: with Charlie Tee: 1991 & Grace Barton Drop of the Week!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec. Diagnostix and Bish are in the studio to deliver a spooky Drum & Bass remix of Tame Impala's Dracula! Plus Koven drops by ahead of their DNB60. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: with Charlie Tee: Halloween Remix Challenge!

name: Radio 1's Drum & Bass Show
